description: VOLTTRON is an open-source software tool listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Buildings and Cities", published or maintained by VOLTTRON (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). The platform provides services for collecting and storing data from buildings and devices and provides an environment for developing applications which interact with that data. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Buildings and Cities" (buildings and cities). The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support buildings and cities studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
